title: Black sliding wallpaper on activity change
line: Switching activities now slides the new wallpaper in over the old one instead of over a black screen.
explanation: When the activity changes, ContainmentView (libplasma) hides the old containment right away, but Desktop.qml then runs its slide animation as if the old one were still there, so the new wallpaper slid in over black. For an activity shown for the first time, its containment and wallpaper are only created at that moment, so the screen stayed black until the image had loaded (about 2 s on the rig). Desktop.qml now shows the old containment again for the switch, keeps the new one off screen until its uiReady (wallpaper loaded) is true, and only then slides it in.

commits.message:
desktop: keep the old activity visible until the new one slides in

The view hides the old containment as soon as the activity changes, so
the screen went black while the new activity loaded and it slid in over
black. Keep the old one shown and start the slide once the new is ready.

BUG: 452104
